---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a firmware feature, example, or documentation addition
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature, example, or documentation you'd like added.

**Why is it useful?**
What problem it solves or what it enables.

**Are you able to help implement it?**
Yes / No / Maybe — if yes, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
